learning_objective: 🎯 Let us travel across beautiful India to see its snowy mountains, golden deserts, and celebrate its colorful festivals!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: India is like a giant puzzle with different pieces! We have freezing snowy mountains in the north, hot sandy deserts in the west, and beautiful green beaches in the south.
Because the weather is different everywhere, people eat different foods and wear different beautiful clothes. Someone in Kerala might eat dosa, while someone in Punjab enjoys makki ki roti!
Even though we speak different languages and celebrate different festivals like Diwali, Eid, and Christmas, we all share love and joy. This makes our country beautifully united!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My India Collage!
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your parents for old newspapers or magazines, and cut out pictures of different Indian clothes, foods, and famous places to stick on a big chart paper!

quick_recap: ⭐ India has very different lands, from high cold mountains to hot deserts and lush green forests.
⭐ People across the country enjoy different types of delicious foods, languages, and clothing.
⭐ Our beautiful diversity is our biggest strength because we live together as one big happy family.
